description: Issue #49: every candidate is anchored to a token start. A dotfile root is extracted whole (".claude/skills/cmate-verify/scripts/verify-run.sh", which `\b` could never reach) and neither "scripts/verify-run.sh" nor "claude/skills/..." nor "src/lib/store.ts" is invented from the middle of a path — suspected_files IS scope.allow, so a partial path is write permission on a file that does not exist. A path:line reference still yields the path alone. Since #177 the anchoring is asserted on reference_files rather than suspected_files for the harness path: the body cites the runner in prose, so it is denied by default and reported as read-not-writable. The assertion #49 exists for is unchanged — the dotfile root is still extracted WHOLE and no partial of it appears anywhere in the plan.
